label: opening a deep link does not drive input
AppleScript that only reads window geometry
command: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to tell process "Slack" to get {position, size} of window 1'

label: a still screenshot, not a recording
ffmpeg transcoding a file, not the screen
authoring a driver script is not running it
command:
cat > /tmp/slack-type.sh <<'EOF'
osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "3"'
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/slack-type.sh

label: grepping for the pattern in a transcript
git grep whose pattern lists the mechanisms (real session, quote-aware split)
command: C=/repo/catstack; cd $C; echo "=== UI input guard"; git grep -n -iE "keystroke|HIDIdleTime|System Events|cliclick|synthetic input" origin/main -- engine corpus 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-140 | head -6

label: python heredoc editing the detector holds the words as data (real session)
command:
cd /repo/hooks/ui-input-guard && python3 - <<'PY'
p='detect.py'; s=open(p).read()
s = s.replace('keystroke', 'key code')  # System Events
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY

label: probing whether a clicker is installed is not clicking
command: which cliclick 2>&1; brew list cliclick 2>&1 | head -3

label: git commit whose message body names the mechanisms
command:
git commit -q -F - <<'MSG'
hook: block cliclick and System Events keystroke input

Body mentioning keystroke and click at.
MSG

label: python -c holding the mechanism words as literals while editing this hook (real session)
command: cd /repo/hooks/ui-input-guard && python3 -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'.'); import detect; print(detect.find_reason('osascript -e tell application System Events to keystroke 3'))"
